guide.eyebrow: User guide · for new and existing members
guide.title: LETŇÁK – Lezecká stěna Tišnov
guide.lede: How to create an account, top up credits or a pass, and enter the wall — step by step.
guide.step1Body: On the home page click Register. Fill in your name, email, phone (optional), and a password (at least 8 characters), then submit.
guide.step2Body: Enter your email and password. The session stays signed in — feel free to add the app to your phone's home screen.
guide.step3Intro: On the home page first tick (red text) the agreement to the operating rules — the entry button stays disabled without it. Then tap the big button showing your remaining entries. The app offers three options:
guide.optionOpenBody: outside staffed hours, the app unlocks the gate directly and deducts one entry. Only open the gate while you're standing right next to it. You'll hear a click and the lock releases for 5 seconds. Pull the gate towards you to open it.
guide.optionProveBody: during staffed hours, show staff your QR code — scanning it deducts your entry.
guide.optionCancelBody: closes the dialog without deducting an entry.
guide.step4Body: In the Buy entries menu, pick a package — either individual entries (credits) or an unlimited-time pass (week / month / year). You can pay by:
guide.methodQrBody: scan the code in your banking app; the payment is matched automatically by variable symbol.
guide.methodGopayBody: instant card/online payment, if enabled for your wall.
guide.tipNoPackagesBody: That means you haven't been assigned a person type yet — contact an admin.
guide.step5Title: Or just pay for one entry
guide.step5Body: If you see Instant payment for entry on the login page or dashboard, you can enter an amount, scan the QR code, and pay on the spot without buying a package — handy for a one-off visit or for paying the equipment rental fee.
guide.stepDependents1Body: In the My account menu, under Companions, enter a name and pick a person type (it determines the price). A companion has no account or password of their own — everything happens under your login.
guide.stepDependents2Body: In the Buy entries menu, switch the For whom section at the top to the companion's name and pay for a package just like for yourself. Only single entries are available for companions, not time-based passes.
guide.stepDependents3Body: On the entry button, check the companion you're bringing along — the app deducts an entry from both of you at once. When you prove your identity to staff with the QR code, your companion selection carries over automatically and staff will see it pre-checked after scanning.
guide.step6Body: The My account menu shows your email, phone, assigned person type, current credit balance, a password-change option, and your full entry and payment history.
guide.explainSuspended: Contact an admin — without their help you can't get onto the wall.
guide.explainNoCredits: Buy more entries or a pass under Buy entries.
guide.explainOutsideHours: Your entry type has a fixed time window — the app won't open the gate outside it.
guide.explainCooldown: There's a short protective pause between two gate openings (cooldown).

guideStaff.title: LETŇÁK – Staff manual
guideStaff.lede: How to log in, enter the wall, and verify entry for members and guests — step by step.
guideStaff.section1Purpose: This section is about you — how to get into the app and open the gate yourself when you come on shift.
guideStaff.step1Body: Enter the email and password an admin set up for you. Feel free to add the app to your phone's home screen.
guideStaff.step2Body: As staff you have unlimited entry — the app needs no credits and no operating-rules agreement from you. Tap Enter the wall, then Open gate.
guideStaff.section2Purpose: This section is about visitors — how to check a member's or guest's entitlement to enter at the door and deduct their entry.
guideStaff.step3Title: Look up a member or guest
guideStaff.step3Intro: In the menu, open Verify pass. There are three ways to identify a visitor:
guideStaff.methodEmailBody: enter the member's email and tap Verify pass.
guideStaff.methodCodeBody: for guests (no account of their own), enter the code from their pass.
guideStaff.methodScanBody: leave the field empty and tap Verify pass — the camera opens. Point it at the QR code the visitor shows on their phone (their Show to staff screen).
guideStaff.step4Body: The app shows remaining entries, pass validity, or remaining guest-pass uses. If the member is bringing companions, tick who's entering with them. The entry is only deducted once you tap Confirm entry.
guideStaff.section3Purpose: This section is about oversight — what got paid and who entered over the recent period, so nothing slips past you.
guideStaff.step5Body: The Payment check menu shows pending payments, the period payment history, unmatched bank transfers, and prepaid-entry usage for the last N days.
guideStaff.tipConfirmBody: You only monitor pending payments here. An admin confirms them under Admin → Payments.
